---
title: "tRNAs in grande and petite *S. cerevisiae*"
---

```{r}
#| label: create_clover
#| eval: false
library(clover)

rse_clover <- create_clover(
  pod5 = list(
    "grande" = clover_data("yeast/grande.pod5"),
    "petite" = clover_data("yeast/petite.pod5")
  ),
  bam = list(
    "grande" = clover_data("yeast/grande.bam"),
    "petite" = clover_data("yeast/petite.bam")
  ),
  bcerr = list(
    "grande" = clover_data("yeast/grande.bcerr.tsv.gz"),
    "petite" = clover_data("yeast/petite.bcerr.tsv.gz")
  ),
  fa = clover_data("yeast/trna-ref.fa.gz"),
  mods = clover_data("yeast/trna-mods.tsv.gz")
)
```
